label: Viking Melk
note: Norwegian tinned evaporated milk, invented by Olav Johan Sopp in 1891; a Nestlé brand since 1897

about.text: Norwegian evaporated milk in a tin, developed by Olav Johan Sopp in 1891 and sold under the Viking Melk name by Nestlé since 1897.
